Class DiskFileStoreAdapter.DiskDirectoryAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.webcodepro.applecommander.storage.DiskFileStoreAdapter.DiskDirectoryAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
CapabilityProvider, Directory, WritableDirectory
Enclosing class:
DiskFileStoreAdapter
public static class DiskFileStoreAdapter.DiskDirectoryAdapter extends Object implements WritableDirectory
The DiskDirectoryEntryAdapter is a shim that allows a FormattedDisk or DirectoryEntry to be mapped into the new/evolving Directory / WritableDirectory and associated interface(s).
